source: Garg et al., Phys. Rev. C 100, 069901(E) (2019), Table I p.1

interpretation_boundary.direct_change: The 747.5 and 813.3 keV lines are assigned mixed M1+E2 character after energy-dependent asymmetry correction.
interpretation_boundary.old_813_claim: The old -0.20(8) polarization asymmetry is replaced by +0.04(3); the old value must not be used as a current M1-purity discriminator.
interpretation_boundary.author_scope: The erratum states that the earlier results and interpretations are not affected; it does not provide absolute lifetimes or absolute B(M1).
interpretation_boundary.not_done: No raw-count likelihood, covariance reconstruction, or independent re-fit was performed.
